title: 3.3 Double Rotations (LR / RL)
objective: Repair LR and RL double-rotation puzzles: click the child pivot first, then the root pivot!
controls: Click child pivot first -> Click root pivot second
start_status: Puzzle 1/2 (LR): Step 1 - Click the child pivot to rotate it first!
hints: A zig-zag (LR) cannot be fixed by one rotation. First rotate the child so the chain becomes straight.
The chain is straight now: rotate the root pivot against the direction it leans.
RL is the mirror of LR: first rotate the right child to straighten the zig-zag.
The chain is straight now: rotate the root pivot to the left.
